name: Strategy 2
description: Foundation rules on 5-minute candles: swings → protected level → CHoCH / BOS by touch → AVWAP pair from the previous SH and SL → SETUP. Stop at the CHoCH candle's high / low; exit on the stop or the next CHoCH.
